title: Create a short URL

body:
## Description

Most URL shorteners save the click counts. It can be essential to know how many times the link got clicked by users. In this stage, we will implement a similar click counter, although we won't save it anywhere.

After creating a short URL, add a new `span` element with the text `Clicks:` inside the list item for the click count. The click count should start with zero and increase every time the user clicks on the short link. Since the link should open in another tab, you should be able to see the increased counts. Each new link should have its own click count.

## Objectives

Your page should:

- Contain a `span` inside a list item with the text `Clicks:`
- Display the click counts in the `span` ;
- Increase the click counts when clicked on the short URL.

## Example

**Example**: *short link click counts*

![Short link click counts](https://ucarecdn.com/60d96488-ac83-420d-9f9c-023bde2ffe21/)
title: Count the clicks

body:
## Description

Now, we can create short URLs and count the clicks, let's add a way to delete them.

First, add a new `button` element in the HTML document with the ID of `button-delete` and the text `Delete`.

The delete action should be as follows:

- If users did not enter any input, after clicking the delete button, remove all the items inside the ordered list;
- Users should be able to delete any short URL if they enter the matching short URL or the original URL;
- If it matches more than one URL, it should delete all the matched items.

You can use the provided IDs to select the elements.

## Objectives

Your page should:

- Contain a `button` with the ID of `button-delete` and the text `Delete`;
- Remove all the list items if there is no input;
- Remove the list items matched with the input.

## Examples

**Example 1**: *deleting the list items with matching input*

![Deleting the list items with matching input](https://ucarecdn.com/90584122-f5f3-48b6-9fa6-c108ed7bf17f/)

**Example 2**: *deleting all the list items*

![Deleting all the list items](https://ucarecdn.com/f995003d-bcf1-45b9-af08-7d72f5edc4b7/)
